programs.title: Mark Berg's Fishing Addiction
programs.desc: Fishing expert Mark Berg visits some of the best fishing destinations around. Chasing a wide variety of fish, Mark is always hoping to capture a new species or develop a new technique.

programs.title: Merv Hughes Fishing
programs.desc: Merv Hughes Fishing is a light hearted fishing show with some ripping catches, a few yarns (mostly true), mateship and of course a splash of comedy thrown in.

programs.title: Creek To Coast
programs.desc: Creek to Coast is all things boating, camping, 4WDing, outdoor adventuring and fishing. From bush-bashing to cooking to caravanning to watersports, Creek to Coast has it all.

programs.title: Mighty Ships
programs.desc: A look at the largest sailing cruise ship in the world, the Wind Surf. A faulty bow thruster and a storm could mean a rough ride, but the captain and crew are determined to make this smooth sailing.

programs.title: Swamp People: Serpent Invasion
programs.desc: Bruce and Zak call in canine reinforcements to sniff out serpents hiding from the rising temperature. Troy, Chase, and Bill hunt on snake island. Troy finds himself alone in the middle of nowhere.

programs.title: Australia ReDiscovered
programs.desc: Ricko heads to WA to check out a story of a crashed WWII plane carrying a fortune, then to an outback NSW pub with an artistic edge, then checks out a once thriving WA port town lost to the elements.

programs.title: American Restoration
programs.desc: Rick gets a visit from Grammy-winning singer Jason Mraz, bringing in a sign to be restored in honor of his late grandfather. Later, the crew converts a classic gas pump into a kick-ass \.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: Lisa decides to be fact-based in Placentia, inadvertently complicating international relations; Ivy and his son conjure up a locker with some mysterious sports equipment.

programs.title: American Pickers: Best Of
programs.desc: Explore the weirdest gadgets ever found, from the first flapper pinball machine to a high-voltage demo, as the team uncovers eccentric, unique machinery.

programs.title: Pawn Stars
programs.sub_title: Best Of - Pawn On The Range
programs.desc: It's time to saddle up with the Pawn Stars as the guys look to buy some rare western memorabilia. Will the Pawn Stars pony up some cash or ride off into the sunset empty handed?

programs.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programs.desc: The Dirt Dogs invest in a hard rock mining plant, while the Gold Gypsies are eager to be back in the field. However, a $20,000 excavator repair is a tough start to the season.

programs.title: Adventure Gold Diggers
programs.desc: Rookie miner Dennis enjoys a personal-best nugget find in a bumper day, while the Mineshaft Hunters' quest for gold is cut short when a team member takes a life-threatening fall.
